purpose: Preliminary, CPU-only test of surrogate-assisted LHFiD at the real budget of 150 evaluations on a simulated problem calibrated to the 900 real v3 evaluations. Fixed before any simulation run. Decides whether the real C2 jobs are launched.
scaling: minimization form; 0 = best value among the 900 real candidates, 1 = reference point (same as configs/nas/surrogate_benchmark.json)

truths.note: HistGradientBoosting fitted on all 900 real evaluations
RandomForest fitted on all 900 real evaluations

internal_surrogate: ExtraTrees (a different family from both truths), refitted each round on the points the run itself has evaluated (noisy values only)
noise: Gaussian noise added to observed CLIP and fidelity only; sigma set per truth so that the reliability of a 96-image measurement among in-box real candidates matches 0.50 for CLIP (measured split-half Spearman-Brown) and 0.90 for fidelity (its calibration-to-validation rank agreement was 0.96); cost objectives are observed without noise

arms.nsga2: direct NSGA-II, population 20 (as in the real searches)
arms.sa_nsga2: 50 random, then 5 rounds of 20: refit surrogate, run NSGA-II on it (population 56, 30 generations), pick 20 novel candidates spread across reference vectors
arms.sa_lhfid: same as sa_nsga2 with LHFiD (p = 1/w) as the inner optimizer
arms.sa_lhfid_noise: sa_lhfid with noise-aware hf-dominance: quality differences smaller than the measured noise SD (in scaled units) count as ties in both the better-count and the weighted sum

indicator: exact 4-D hypervolume (moocore) of all evaluated points, computed on the noise-free truth, scaled space, reference 1
statistics: Mann-Whitney U (two-sided) per arm pair within each truth, Holm-corrected over pairs; a ranking is claimed only if it holds under both truths
decision_rule: launch real C2 jobs only if sa_lhfid (or sa_lhfid_noise) beats random and nsga2 with Holm p < 0.05 under both truths and is not significantly worse than sa_nsga2
